definitions.explanation: The age of nineteen. In Japan, this is the final year before legal adulthood ({成人|せいじん}) at age 20, though the legal age of majority for most civil-law purposes was lowered to 18 in 2022. Nineteen-year-olds are usually first- or second-year university students, or young workers in their second post–high-school year.

examples.japanese: {息子|むすこ}は{十九歳|じゅうきゅうさい}です。
examples.english: My son is nineteen years old.

examples.japanese: {十九歳|じゅうきゅうさい}で{大学|だいがく}に{入|はい}った。
{十九歳|じゅうきゅうさい}の{誕生日|たんじょうび}に{家族|かぞく}でレストランに{行|い}った。
examples.english: For my nineteenth birthday, we went to a restaurant as a family.

examples.japanese: {十九歳|じゅうきゅうさい}の{時|とき}、{初|はじ}めて{一人|ひとり}で{海外|かいがい}{旅行|りょこう}に{行|い}って、{世界|せかい}が{広|ひろ}がった{気|き}がした。
examples.english: At nineteen, I traveled abroad alone for the first time, and it felt like my world had widened.

notes:
Composed of {十九|じゅうきゅう} (nineteen) and the age counter {〜歳|さい} (years of age).

PRONUNCIATION:
Note the special reading {十九|じゅうきゅう} — in isolation, 19 can also be read じゅうく, but for the age compound {十九歳|じゅうきゅうさい}, じゅうきゅう is the standard reading. The {歳|さい} counter can also be written {才|さい} in informal contexts.

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, traditional coming-of-age age is 20, celebrated at {成人式|せいじんしき} (the Coming-of-Age Ceremony). Since the 2022 civil-code change lowering the age of majority to 18, nineteen-year-olds are adults for most legal purposes, but drinking and smoking remain restricted until 20. In many families, the nineteenth birthday still feels like the last year of "being a kid."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {十九歳|じゅうきゅうさい}の{誕生日|たんじょうび}: nineteenth birthday
- {十九歳|じゅうきゅうさい}の{時|とき}: when I was nineteen
- {十九歳|じゅうきゅうさい}で: at nineteen (at the age of)
- {十九歳|じゅうきゅうさい}の{若者|わかもの}: a young person of nineteen

RELATED AGES:
- {十八歳|じゅうはっさい}: eighteen years old — now the legal age of adulthood in Japan
- {二十歳|はたち}: twenty years old — special non-compositional reading; the traditional coming-of-age
- {二十一歳|にじゅういっさい}: twenty-one years old
